stagnation.policy: Detection/reporting always enabled. Stopping disabled by default; maximum candidate attempts unchanged.

config.source_grounding: Original source plus ontology/representation only; model judgments remain interpretations
config.candidate_attempt_definition: Initial generation plus every code revision. Reviewer format retries are separate.

provider_capabilities.verification: Upstream Azure documented; Aalto gateway/model capability unverified. No online capability probe.

authorization: PREPARED_ONLY_NOT_AUTHORIZED_OR_DISPATCHED; user will launch only after blocker resolved
token_limits: Per request: generation/repair16000, review/correction4000;128000 reserved output-token ceiling. Input bounded by110000 serialized UTF8 bytes/call, never silently truncated; exact provider tokens recorded when supplied.
final_review: Deterministic terminal review handoff; no additional call or repair; ACCEPTED/UNVERIFIED delivery and APPROVE/HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED/REJECT remain distinct

readiness_blockers.TRF-010: Initial complete packet exceeds conservative110000-byte request bound; hosted tokenizer/capacity not verified; no truncation
readiness_blockers.TRF-035: Initial complete packet exceeds conservative110000-byte request bound; hosted tokenizer/capacity not verified; no truncation

blocker: Required hosted review stage was not exercised: frozen110000-byte request guard rejected repaired-candidate review. No main dispatch until a separately verified capacity/budget correction.

prior_exposure.IMO-001: Earlier Aalto development pilot; smoke requirements additionally exposed in upcoming smoke
prior_exposure.I2-005: Earlier Aalto development pilot; smoke requirements additionally exposed in upcoming smoke

not_run_policy: Predeclared readiness blockers and insufficient-time entries remain NOT_RUN, separately from started model/workflow failures

configured_token_ceiling.note: No hosted tokenizer or pinned revision exposed; exact input-token upper bound not verified. Exact bytes bounded and actual usage retained. This remains an additional main-readiness limitation.
